entities.name: Amicie de Montfort
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Amicie de Montfort was a French noblewoman and nun. In the Montfort family, which had many people called Simon or Amicie, she became widely known as the daughter of the man, Simon de Montfort, 5th Earl of Leicester, who fought in the Albigensian Crusade in France.
